description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git checkout-index' command, specifically the behavior with and without the '-u' flag. It sets up test cases, runs Git commands, and checks the output to ensure correct functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks results.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting failure as part of test validation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
